text:
maya: Kicking off rollout for `routing-unified` feature flag. Starting 10% canary, drain window 3m. /deploy start --flag=routing-unified=true --canary=10% --pin=model-routing:v2.3.1-delta
liam: Ack. What's our rollback criteria?
maya: Error rate > 1.5% on canary OR p99 latency > 200ms sustained for 5m. Also watch queue depth.
ash: adding: if queue_depth > 500 on the worker pool, pause rollout automatically.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued rollout id=rb-4987654322, state=scheduled, eta=2026-03-21T15:02Z :robot_face:
maya: We'll pin model-routing v2.3.1-delta for the canary to avoid auto-model-swap.
liam: Noted. I'll notify product + CS. /release-notes draft: "unified routing toggle (canary), fixes for routing edge-case tokenization"
maya: @oncall-tim can you watch the drain and the GPU queue metrics? Set a short alert for qdepth>300.
oncall-tim: On it, alert rule created (qdepth > 300 for 2m). I'll monitor dashboards.
ash: If we need a fast rollback: ` /deploy rollback rb-4987654322 ` and unpin model. Keep a prepared rollback note.
liam: Also capturing sample prompts for eval if we see quality regression.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] rolling to 10% -> 25% after 10m if health OK. smoke-tests: passed.
maya: Smoke tests green, progressing.
liam: Standing by for alerts :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] rollout paused at 25% due to elevated p99 latency on canary hosts (p99=312ms).
maya: Pausing automatic rollback. Prefer hold for 10m while we try to scale the pool.
nash: Tried scale, hitting GPU allocation delays in eu-west-1, spin-up backlog ~6m. Recommend rollback if that's the case.
maya: Agree. Executing rollback now.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] rollback executed, state=rolled_back, reason="p99 latency spike + GPU allocation fail", rolled_to=0%.
liam: Re-open ticket to investigate routing kernel selection/regression. Assign to eng-runtime and infra.
maya: Creating ticket and adding release note: "Rollout suspended due to latency spike; rollback executed. Investigating model kernel selection and infra allocation." :memo:
oncall-tim: Will keep monitoring main path and queue-drain metrics, will post updates.
nash: Next attempt after infra fix + smaller canary (5%) and a shorter drain window.
maya: Thanks team. We'll regroup after infra patch. :heart:
